Messages.Author: agzocgud
Messages.Body:
A 5-cap sabbat vampire with 2 blood, perfectionist, harvest rites and
vamperic disease takes an unblocked hunt action and no reactions were
played. How much blood does it end up with (and why)?

Messages.Author: MrJ
Messages.Body:
On 31 Aug, 23:33, agzocgud <per_math...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> A 5-cap sabbat vampire with 2 blood, perfectionist, harvest rites and
> vamperic disease takes an unblocked hunt action and no reactions were
> played. How much blood does it end up with (and why)?

I'd say it gains 1, from Perfectionist. (Ending up with 3 blood)

Perf gives blood after the action, so it's not part of the hunt.
HR gives "an additional blood" when hunting, so that is lost due to VD
